```{r covariates}
# ── Scalar covariates — edit this vector to change the covariate set ──────────
z_vars <- c("age_in_years", "bmi")

# Encode character/factor variables in z_vars as numeric columns:
#   - binary (2 levels)   → single 0/1 column, keeps original name
#   - multi-level (k > 2) → k-1 treatment dummies (ref = first level
#                            alphabetically), named <var><level>
# Returns list(df = modified dataframe, z_vars = updated variable names).
encode_z <- function(df, z_vars) {
  out_vars <- character(0)
  for (v in z_vars) {
    x <- df[[v]]
    if (is.numeric(x) || is.integer(x)) {
      out_vars <- c(out_vars, v)
    } else {
      lvls <- sort(unique(na.omit(as.character(x))))
      if (length(lvls) == 2) {
        df[[v]] <- as.integer(factor(x, levels = lvls)) - 1L
        out_vars <- c(out_vars, v)
      } else {
        # k-1 treatment-coded dummies; reference = lvls[1]
        fac   <- factor(x, levels = lvls)
        mm    <- model.matrix(~ fac)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
        dnames <- paste0(v, lvls[-1])
        colnames(mm) <- dnames
        df    <- cbind(df, as.data.frame(mm))
        out_vars <- c(out_vars, dnames)
      }
    }
  }
  list(df = df, z_vars = out_vars)
}

enc1       <- encode_z(df_post1_r, z_vars)  # encode both with original z_vars
enc2       <- encode_z(df_post2_r, z_vars)
df_post1_r <- enc1$df
df_post2_r <- enc2$df
z_vars     <- enc1$z_vars   # updated names (dummies replace factor columns)
```

```{r}
# ── Representative covariate means for z_vars by group ───────────────────────
# Returns a named numeric vector of means (or modes for binary-encoded vars).
z_rep_vals <- function(df, z_vars, group) {
  sub <- df[df$is_user == group, z_vars, drop = FALSE]
  vapply(z_vars, function(v) mean(sub[[v]], na.rm = TRUE), numeric(1))
}
z_means1_user    <- z_rep_vals(df_post1_r, z_vars, 1)
z_means1_nonuser <- z_rep_vals(df_post1_r, z_vars, 0)
z_means2_user    <- z_rep_vals(df_post2_r, z_vars, 1)
z_means2_nonuser <- z_rep_vals(df_post2_r, z_vars, 0)

# Legacy scalar aliases (used in plotting code); update if z_vars changes
age_mean_user     <- if ("age_in_years" %in% z_vars) z_means1_user["age_in_years"]    else NA
age_mean_nonuser  <- if ("age_in_years" %in% z_vars) z_means1_nonuser["age_in_years"] else NA
age_mean_user2    <- if ("age_in_years" %in% z_vars) z_means2_user["age_in_years"]    else NA
age_mean_nonuser2 <- if ("age_in_years" %in% z_vars) z_means2_nonuser["age_in_years"] else NA
```

```{r}
fit_mgcv <- function(data, family, sgrid, visit = "post1", compute_surv = TRUE,
                     z_vars = get("z_vars", envir = .GlobalEnv),
                     z_means_user = NULL, z_means_nonuser = NULL) {
  # Handles LFCM and AFCM only. For functional AFT models use fit_lfAFT()/fit_afAFT().
  # Set compute_surv = FALSE in CV loops (only [[1]] is needed) to skip the
  # representative-subject survival computation.
  n <- nrow(data)
  if (visit == "post1") { sgrid <- sgrid1 } else { sgrid <- sgrid2 }
  nS <- length(sgrid)

  X     <- as.matrix(data[, grep("^pct_chg_", colnames(data))])
  delta <- data$is_user
  Y     <- data$time_since_use

  lvec <- matrix(1 / nS, nS, 1)
  L    <- kronecker(matrix(1, n, 1), t(lvec))
  S    <- kronecker(matrix(1, n, 1), t(sgrid))

  # Build data2 with functional covariates + selected scalar covariates
  data2 <- data.frame(Y = Y, delta = delta, X = I(X), L = I(L),
                      X_L = I(X * L), S = I(S))
  data2 <- cbind(data2, data[, z_vars, drop = FALSE])

  # Dynamic GAM formula
  z_str <- paste(z_vars, collapse = " + ")
  gam_ctrl <- gam.control(maxit = 200)
  if (family == "LFCM") {
    form <- as.formula(paste("Y ~", z_str, "+ s(S, by = X_L, bs = 'cr', k = 20)"))
    fit  <- gam(form, weights = delta, data = data2, family = cox.ph,
                optimizer = "efs", control = gam_ctrl)
  } else if (family == "AFCM") {
    form <- as.formula(paste("Y ~", z_str,
                             "+ ti(X, S, by = L, bs = c('cr', 'cr'), k = c(20, 20), mc = c(TRUE, FALSE))"))
    fit  <- gam(form, weights = delta, data = data2, family = cox.ph,
                optimizer = "efs", control = gam_ctrl)
  } else {
    stop(sprintf("fit_mgcv(): unknown family '%s'. Use fit_lfAFT() or fit_afAFT() for functional AFT models.", family))
  }

  if (compute_surv) {
    tgrid_surv <- seq(0.1, 120, len = 500)
    L1 <- kronecker(matrix(1, 1, 1), t(lvec))
    S1 <- kronecker(matrix(1, 1, 1), t(sgrid))
    if (visit == "post1") {
      pup_u  <- pupil_means_user;    pup_nu <- pupil_means_nonuser
      zm_u   <- z_means_user  %||% z_means1_user
      zm_nu  <- z_means_nonuser %||% z_means1_nonuser
    } else {
      pup_u  <- pupil_means_user2;   pup_nu <- pupil_means_nonuser2
      zm_u   <- z_means_user  %||% z_means2_user
      zm_nu  <- z_means_nonuser %||% z_means2_nonuser
    }
    make_surv_df <- function(pup, zm) {
      df <- data.frame(X = I(pup), L = I(L1), X_L = I(pup * L1), S = I(S1))
      for (v in z_vars) df[[v]] <- zm[[v]]
      df
    }
    df_surv_user    <- make_surv_df(pup_u,  zm_u)
    df_surv_nonuser <- make_surv_df(pup_nu, zm_nu)
    surv_user    <- cal_stime(fit = fit, data = df_surv_user,    tgrid = tgrid_surv, family = "cox.ph")
    surv_nonuser <- cal_stime(fit = fit, data = df_surv_nonuser, tgrid = tgrid_surv, family = "cox.ph")
  } else {
    surv_user    <- NULL
    surv_nonuser <- NULL
  }

  return(list(fit, surv_user, surv_nonuser, data2))
}
# Null-coalescing helper
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b
```

```{r scalar cox models}
# ── Compute AUC of pupil response via trapezoidal rule ────────────────────────
trap_auc <- function(x, grid) sum(diff(grid) * (head(x, -1) + tail(x, -1)) / 2)

df_post1_r$auc <- apply(df_post1_r[, pct_cols1], 1, trap_auc, grid = sgrid1)
df_post2_r$auc <- apply(df_post2_r[, pct_cols2], 1, trap_auc, grid = sgrid2)

# PMC = PCBlood (plasma marijuana concentration); change to PCTT if preferred
df_post1_r$PMC <- df_post1_r$PCBlood
df_post2_r$PMC <- df_post2_r$PCBlood

# ── Assessment 1: fit two scalar Cox models ───────────────────────────────────
cox1_pmc <- coxph(Surv(time_since_use, is_user) ~ age_in_years + bmi + PMC,
                  data = df_post1_r, ties = "efron")
cox1_auc <- coxph(Surv(time_since_use, is_user) ~ age_in_years + bmi + auc,
                  data = df_post1_r, ties = "efron")

cat("=== Cox model 1a: age + BMI + PMC (Assessment 1) ===\n"); print(summary(cox1_pmc))
cat("\n=== Cox model 1b: age + BMI + AUC (Assessment 1) ===\n"); print(summary(cox1_auc))

# ── PH assumption tests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ph_test <- function(fit, label) {
  cat(sprintf("\n── PH tests: %s ──\n", label))

  # (1) Grambsch-Therneau Schoenfeld test
  cat("(1) Schoenfeld residuals (cox.zph):\n")
  zph <- cox.zph(fit, transform = "log")
  print(zph)

  # (2) Time-interaction LRT via tt()
  vars   <- names(coef(fit))
  z_str  <- paste(vars, collapse = " + ")
  tt_str <- paste(sprintf("tt(%s)", vars), collapse = " + ")
  fit_ph <- coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(time_since_use, is_user) ~", z_str)),
                  data = fit$model, ties = "efron")
  fit_tv <- coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(time_since_use, is_user) ~",
                                   z_str, "+", tt_str)),
                  tt = function(x, t, ...) x * log(t + 1),
                  data = fit$model, ties = "efron")
  lrt_stat <- 2 * (fit_tv$loglik[2] - fit_ph$loglik[2])
  lrt_df   <- length(grep("^tt\\(", names(coef(fit_tv))))
  cat(sprintf("(2) Time-interaction LRT: chi-sq = %.3f, df = %d, p = %.4f\n",
              lrt_stat, lrt_df, pchisq(lrt_stat, lrt_df, lower.tail = FALSE)))

  # (3) Log-log KM plot stratified by LP quartile
  lp <- predict(fit, type = "lp")
  lp_q <- cut(lp, breaks = quantile(lp, 0:4/4), include.lowest = TRUE,
              labels = c("Q1","Q2","Q3","Q4"))
  df_tmp <- fit$model; df_tmp$lp_q <- lp_q
  km <- survfit(Surv(time_since_use, is_user) ~ lp_q, data = df_tmp)
  cols <- c("#2166AC","#4DAC26","#D6604D","#762A83")
  plot(km, fun = "cloglog", col = cols, lty = 1:4, lwd = 1.5,
       xlab = "log(Time since use, min)", ylab = "log(-log(S(t)))",
       main = sprintf("Log-log plot by LP quartile\n%s", label))
  legend("topleft", paste0("Q", 1:4), col = cols, lty = 1:4, bty = "n", cex = 0.8)

  invisible(list(zph = zph, lrt_stat = lrt_stat,
                 lrt_pval = pchisq(lrt_stat, lrt_df, lower.tail = FALSE)))
}

par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
ph1_pmc <- ph_test(cox1_pmc, "Assessment 1 — age + BMI + PMC")
ph1_auc <- ph_test(cox1_auc, "Assessment 1 — age + BMI + AUC")
```

```{r}
# Bootstrap CIs for a specific mgcv term's contribution over newdata rows
boot_ci_gam <- function(fit, newdata, term_pattern = "s\\(S\\):X_L",
                         B = 500, conf = 0.95, seed = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  a2 <- (1 - conf) / 2
  nnew <- nrow(newdata)

  # Identify the column name for the target term in predict(type='terms')
  tmp <- mgcv::predict.gam(fit, newdata = newdata[1, , drop = FALSE], type = "terms")
  term_col <- grep(term_pattern, colnames(tmp), value = TRUE)
  if (length(term_col) != 1L) {
    stop("Could not uniquely identify the term column. ",
         "Matched: ", paste(term_col, collapse = ", "))
  }

  # Point estimate from the original fit
  est_terms <- mgcv::predict.gam(fit, newdata = newdata, type = "terms", se.fit = FALSE)
  est <- as.numeric(est_terms[, term_col])

  # Prepare bootstrap storage
  boot_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = B, ncol = nnew)

  # Resampling base: model frame preserves censored-normal 2-col response, weights, etc.
  mf <- stats::model.frame(fit)
  n  <- nrow(mf)

  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    idx <- sample.int(n, size = n, replace = TRUE)
    mf_b <- mf[idx, , drop = FALSE]

    # Refit with identical formula/family/smoothing setup on resampled data
    fit_b <- try(stats::update(fit, data = mf_b), silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(fit_b, "try-error")) next

    # Predict term on fixed grid newdata
    pred_b <- try(mgcv::predict.gam(fit_b, newdata = newdata, type = "terms"),
                  silent = TRUE)
    if (inherits(pred_b, "try-error")) next

    # In rare cases term ordering can differ; re-find the column by name
    col_b <- match(term_col, colnames(pred_b))
    if (is.na(col_b)) {
      # fall back to regex
      col_b <- grep(term_pattern, colnames(pred_b))
      if (length(col_b) != 1L) next
    }
    boot_mat[b, ] <- as.numeric(pred_b[, col_b])
  }

  ok <- rowSums(is.finite(boot_mat)) > 0
  used <- sum(ok)
  if (used < max(30, 0.2 * B)) warning("Many bootstrap failures; CIs may be unstable.")

  qfun <- function(x) stats::quantile(x, probs = c(a2, 1 - a2), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
  ci_mat <- apply(boot_mat[ok, , drop = FALSE], 2, qfun)
  ci_lower <- as.numeric(ci_mat[1, ])
  ci_upper <- as.numeric(ci_mat[2, ])

  data.frame(
    idx = seq_len(nnew),
    est = est,
    ci_lower = ci_lower,
    ci_upper = ci_upper,
    used = used
  )
}
```

```{r, PH assumption tests}
# ── Proportional Hazards Assumption Tests for LFCM and AFCM ──────────────────
# Three complementary approaches:
#   1. Scalar coxph + cox.zph(): per-covariate Schoenfeld test for age & BMI.
#   2. tt() time-interaction test: explicit LRT for whether age/BMI HR varies
#      with log(t) — significant coefficient => PH violated for that covariate.
#   3. Log-log KM plot stratified by LFCM linear predictor quartile: visual
#      check for the functional component (parallel => PH plausible).

# ── Helper: run all three tests for one assessment ───────────────────────────
ph_diagnostics <- function(fit_list, raw_data, label) {
  d   <- fit_list[[4]]          # internal data2: Y = time, delta = event
  lp  <- predict(fit_list[[1]], type = "link")

  cat(sprintf("

══════════════════════════════════════════
"))
  cat(sprintf("  PH Diagnostics: %s
", label))
  cat(sprintf("══════════════════════════════════════════
"))

  # ── 1. Scalar coxph: Schoenfeld test for selected z_vars ─────────────────
  cat(sprintf("
--- (1) Grambsch-Therneau test (scalar covariates: %s) ---
", paste(z_vars, collapse = ", ")))
  z_formula_d <- paste(paste0("d$", z_vars), collapse = " + ")
  fit_scalar <- coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(d$Y, d$delta) ~", z_formula_d)))
  zph_scalar <- cox.zph(fit_scalar, transform = "log")
  print(zph_scalar)

  # ── 2. tt() time-interaction LRT ─────────────────────────────────────────
  cat(sprintf("
--- (2) Time-interaction test via tt(): %s * log(t) ---
", paste(z_vars, collapse = ", ")))
  z_str  <- paste(z_vars, collapse = " + ")
  tt_str <- paste(paste0("tt(", z_vars, ")"), collapse = " + ")
  fit_ph <- coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(time_since_use, is_user) ~", z_str)),
                  data = raw_data)
  fit_tv <- coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(time_since_use, is_user) ~", z_str, "+", tt_str)),
                  tt = function(x, t, ...) x * log(t + 1),
                  data = raw_data)
  # tt() expands the dataset internally so anova() fails on size mismatch;
  # use manual LRT from log-likelihoods instead.
  lrt_stat <- 2 * (fit_tv$loglik[2] - fit_ph$loglik[2])
  lrt_df   <- length(grep("^tt\\(", names(coef(fit_tv))))
  lrt_pval <- pchisq(lrt_stat, df = lrt_df, lower.tail = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("  LRT chi-sq = %.4f, df = %d, p = %.4f\n", lrt_stat, lrt_df, lrt_pval))
  cat("  tt() coefficients (non-zero => time-varying HR):\n")
  tv_coefs <- coef(fit_tv)[grep("^tt\\(", names(coef(fit_tv)))]
  print(round(tv_coefs, 4))

  # ── 3. Schoenfeld test on functional LP directly ─────────────────────────
  # Fit a scalar Cox with the functional LP as the sole predictor.
  # This makes the df=1 logic transparent: there is one functional effect
  # (one integral), so one Schoenfeld residual is both correct and complete.
  cat("
--- (3) Schoenfeld test on functional linear predictor ---
")
  lp_df     <- data.frame(Y = d$Y, delta = d$delta, lp = lp)
  fit_lp    <- coxph(Surv(Y, delta) ~ lp, data = lp_df)
  zph_lp    <- cox.zph(fit_lp, transform = "log")
  print(zph_lp)

  # ── 4. Time-interaction LRT on functional LP ──────────────────────────────
  cat("
--- (4) Time-interaction test on functional LP: LP * log(t) ---
")
  fit_ph_lp <- coxph(Surv(time_since_use, is_user) ~ lp,
                     data = cbind(raw_data, lp = lp))
  fit_tv_lp <- coxph(Surv(time_since_use, is_user) ~ lp + tt(lp),
                     tt = function(x, t, ...) x * log(t + 1),
                     data = cbind(raw_data, lp = lp))
  lrt_lp    <- 2 * (fit_tv_lp$loglik[2] - fit_ph_lp$loglik[2])
  pval_lp   <- pchisq(lrt_lp, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf("  LRT chi-sq = %.4f, df = 1, p = %.4f\n", lrt_lp, pval_lp))
  cat(sprintf("  tt(LP) coef = %.4f (non-zero => time-varying functional HR)\n",
              coef(fit_tv_lp)["tt(lp)"]))

  # ── 5. Schoenfeld test with individual + global p-values ─────────────────
  # Decompose GAM prediction into per-term contributions so that cox.zph()
  # can return one row per component (functional smooth, each scalar covariate)
  # plus a GLOBAL row — the standard individual+global layout.
  # Note: cox.zph() cannot be called directly on a gam object; we rebuild a
  # coxph using the term-level predicted values as separate numeric predictors.
  # This works for both LFCM and AFCM: for AFCM the ti(X,S,by=L,...) smooth
  # returns one integrated scalar per subject, just like the LFCM smooth.
  cat("
--- (5) Schoenfeld test: individual (per term) + global p-values ---
")
  zph_terms <- tryCatch({
    terms_mat <- predict(fit_list[[1]], type = "terms")   # n x n_terms matrix

    # Flatten any matrix-valued columns (can occur for AFCM matrix predictors)
    # and drop zero-variance terms that would make coxph singular.
    term_df <- as.data.frame(
      lapply(seq_len(ncol(terms_mat)), function(j) as.numeric(terms_mat[, j]))
    )
    term_cols_raw <- colnames(terms_mat)
    term_cols     <- make.names(term_cols_raw)
    # Ensure uniqueness after make.names (edge case with very long smooth names)
    term_cols     <- make.unique(term_cols)
    colnames(term_df) <- term_cols

    # Drop zero-variance columns (degenerate terms cause coxph rank deficiency)
    ok_cols   <- term_cols[vapply(term_df, function(x) var(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 1e-12, logical(1))]
    term_df   <- term_df[, ok_cols, drop = FALSE]
    term_df$Y     <- d$Y
    term_df$delta <- d$delta

    cat(sprintf("  Terms extracted: %s\n", paste(ok_cols, collapse = ", ")))

    f_terms   <- as.formula(paste("Surv(Y, delta) ~",
                                  paste(ok_cols, collapse = " + ")))
    fit_terms <- coxph(f_terms, data = term_df, ties = "efron")
    zph_out   <- cox.zph(fit_terms, transform = "log")
    print(zph_out)
    zph_out
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat(sprintf("  [Test 5 failed: %s]\n", e$message))
    NULL
  })

  # ── 6. Log-log plot stratified by LP quartile ─────────────────────────────
  cat("
--- (6) Log-log KM plot by linear predictor quartile ---
")
  raw_data$lp_quartile <- cut(lp, breaks = quantile(lp, probs = 0:4/4),
                               include.lowest = TRUE,
                               labels = c("Q1 (low)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4 (high)"))
  km_q <- survfit(Surv(time_since_use, is_user) ~ lp_quartile, data = raw_data)
  cols <- c("#2166AC", "#4DAC26", "#D6604D", "#762A83")
  plot(km_q, fun = "cloglog",
       col = cols, lty = 1:4, lwd = 1.5,
       xlab = "log(Time since cannabis use, min)",
       ylab = "log(-log(S(t)))",
       main = sprintf("Log-log Plot by LP Quartile
%s", label))
  legend("topleft",
         legend = c("Q1 (low risk)", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4 (high risk)"),
         col = cols, lty = 1:4, lwd = 1.5, bty = "n", cex = 0.85)

  invisible(list(zph_scalar = zph_scalar, lrt_stat  = lrt_stat,  lrt_pval = lrt_pval,
                 zph_lp     = zph_lp,     lrt_lp   = lrt_lp,    pval_lp  = pval_lp,
                 zph_terms  = zph_terms))
}

# ── Assessment 1: LFCM ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# ── Assessment 2: LFCM ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

```{r cross validation 1}
library(survAUC)
library(pROC)

# ── Helper functions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Build mgcv-style data structure for a dataset
make_data2 <- function(data, sgrid, z_vars = get("z_vars", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
  n   <- nrow(data)
  nS  <- length(sgrid)
  X   <- as.matrix(data[, grep("^pct_chg_", colnames(data))])
  delta <- data$is_user
  Y   <- data$time_since_use
  logY <- cbind(log(Y), log(Y)); logY[delta == 0, 2] <- Inf
  lvec <- matrix(1 / nS, nS, 1)
  L    <- kronecker(matrix(1, n, 1), t(lvec))
  S    <- kronecker(matrix(1, n, 1), t(sgrid))
  base <- data.frame(Y = Y, delta = delta, X = I(X), L = I(L),
                     X_L = I(X * L), S = I(S), logY = I(logY))
  cbind(base, data[, z_vars, drop = FALSE])
}

# IPCW Integrated Brier Score (trapezoidal, normalized by time range)
# IPCW Integrated Brier Score: evaluates at observed event times in the test set
# (trapezoidal first interval + right Riemann sum, normalized by max event time)
cal_IPCW_IBS <- function(S_mat, time_test, event_test, time_train, event_train, tgrid) {
  n_test  <- length(time_test)
  km_cens <- survfit(Surv(time_train, 1 - event_train) ~ 1)
  get_G <- function(t_vals) {
    sf     <- stepfun(km_cens$time, c(1, km_cens$surv))
    G_vals <- sf(t_vals)
    G_vals[G_vals == 0] <- min(km_cens$surv[km_cens$surv > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
    G_vals
  }
  utimes <- sort(unique(time_test[event_test == 1]))
  if (length(utimes) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  Brier_t <- vapply(utimes, function(ti) {
    col_idx <- max(which(tgrid <= ti))
    S_ti    <- S_mat[, col_idx]
    idx1    <- (time_test <= ti) & (event_test == 1)
    idx2    <- time_test > ti
    (sum(S_ti[idx1]^2 / get_G(time_test[idx1])) +
       sum((1 - S_ti[idx2])^2 / get_G(ti))) / n_test
  }, numeric(1))
  iBrier <- 0.5 * utimes[1] * Brier_t[1]
  if (length(utimes) > 1)
    iBrier <- iBrier + sum(Brier_t[-1] * diff(utimes))
  iBrier / max(utimes)
}

# IPCW Brier Score at a single time point
cal_IPCW_BS_t <- function(S_t, time_test, event_test, time_train, event_train, t_star) {
  n_test  <- length(time_test)
  km_cens <- survfit(Surv(time_train, 1 - event_train) ~ 1)
  get_G <- function(t_vals) {
    sf     <- stepfun(km_cens$time, c(1, km_cens$surv))
    G_vals <- sf(t_vals)
    G_vals[G_vals == 0] <- min(km_cens$surv[km_cens$surv > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
    G_vals
  }
  idx1 <- (time_test <= t_star) & (event_test == 1)
  idx2 <- time_test > t_star
  (sum((S_t[idx1]^2) / get_G(time_test[idx1])) +
     sum(((1 - S_t[idx2])^2) / get_G(t_star))) / n_test
}

# ── Cross-validation setup ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Keep only columns needed for modelling; drops singleton factors (mtm, eye, etc.)
keep_cols1 <- c("time_since_use", "is_user", z_vars,
                grep("^pct_chg_", colnames(df_post1_r), value = TRUE))
cv_data1 <- df_post1_r[, keep_cols1]

set.seed(916)
n_folds <- 10
fold    <- createFolds(cv_data1$time_since_use, k = n_folds, list = FALSE)
tgrid   <- seq(0.1, 120, len = 500)   # for IPCW IBS; follow-up window [0.1, 120] min
t_eval  <- 120                         # time point for time-specific comparison

model_names <- c("scalar lognormal AFT", "loglogistic lfAFT", "lognormal lfAFT",
                 "lognormal afAFT", "LFCM", "AFCM", "func logistic")
n_surv <- 6  # number of survival models

# Helpers for creating metric matrices
new_mat      <- function() matrix(NA, n_folds, 7,      dimnames = list(NULL, model_names))
new_mat_surv <- function() matrix(NA, n_folds, n_surv, dimnames = list(NULL, model_names[1:6]))

IBS_cv    <- new_mat_surv(); IBS_tr    <- new_mat_surv()
BS60_cv   <- new_mat();      BS60_tr   <- new_mat()
BS120_cv  <- new_mat();      BS120_tr  <- new_mat()
Cindex_cv <- new_mat();      Cindex_tr <- new_mat()
Sens_cv   <- new_mat();      Sens_tr   <- new_mat()
Spec_cv   <- new_mat();      Spec_tr   <- new_mat()


for (k in 1:n_folds) {
  cat(sprintf("Assessment 1 — Fold %d / %d\n", k, n_folds))

  train_data <- cv_data1[-which(fold == k), ]
  test_data  <- cv_data1[ which(fold == k), ]

  # Add required columns
  train_data$X_mat       <- as.matrix(train_data[, grep("^pct_chg_", colnames(train_data))])
  test_data$X_mat        <- as.matrix(test_data[,  grep("^pct_chg_", colnames(test_data))])
  train_data$is_user_120 <- as.integer(train_data$time_since_use <= t_eval)
  test_data$is_user_120  <- as.integer(test_data$time_since_use  <= t_eval)

  time_train  <- train_data$time_since_use; event_train <- train_data$is_user
  time_test   <- test_data$time_since_use;  event_test  <- test_data$is_user
  Surv_train  <- Surv(time_train, event_train)
  Surv_test   <- Surv(time_test,  event_test)
  truth120       <- as.integer(time_test  <= t_eval & event_test  == 1)
  truth120_train <- as.integer(time_train <= t_eval & event_train == 1)
  t_idx   <- which.min(abs(tgrid - t_eval))
  t_idx60 <- which.min(abs(tgrid - 60))

  # Drop z_vars with zero/near-zero variance in this training fold (prevents GCV failure)
  z_vars_fold <- z_vars[vapply(z_vars, function(v) {
    x <- train_data[[v]]; !all(is.na(x)) && var(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 1e-10
  }, logical(1))]
  if (length(z_vars_fold) == 0) z_vars_fold <- z_vars[1]


  train_data2 <- make_data2(train_data, sgrid1, z_vars = z_vars_fold)
  test_data2  <- make_data2(test_data,  sgrid1, z_vars = z_vars_fold)

  # Youden's J optimal threshold (from training-fold in-sample predictions)
  get_youden <- function(prob_tr, truth_tr) {
    if (length(unique(na.omit(truth_tr))) < 2) return(NA_real_)
    tryCatch({
      roc_obj <- roc(truth_tr, prob_tr, quiet = TRUE)
      as.numeric(unlist(coords(roc_obj, "best", best.method = "youden", ret = "threshold")))[1]
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  }
  sens_spec <- function(p_event, thresh, truth) {
    pred <- as.integer(p_event > thresh)
    list(sens = if (any(truth == 1)) mean(pred[truth == 1]) else NA,
         spec = if (any(truth == 0)) mean(1 - pred[truth == 0]) else NA)
  }

  # ── 1. Scalar lognormal AFT ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  scalar_form  <- as.formula(paste("Surv(time_since_use, is_user) ~", paste(z_vars_fold, collapse = " + ")))
  fit_scalar   <- survreg(scalar_form, data = train_data, dist = "lognormal")
  sigma_scalar <- fit_scalar$scale
  eta_scalar   <- predict(fit_scalar, newdata = test_data,  type = "lp")
  eta_scalar_tr <- predict(fit_scalar, newdata = train_data, type = "lp")
  S_scalar    <- outer(eta_scalar,    tgrid, function(mu, t) pnorm((log(t) - mu) / sigma_scalar, lower.tail = FALSE))
  S_scalar_tr <- outer(eta_scalar_tr, tgrid, function(mu, t) pnorm((log(t) - mu) / sigma_scalar, lower.tail = FALSE))
  p_event_scalar    <- 1 - S_scalar[,    t_idx]
  p_event_scalar_tr <- 1 - S_scalar_tr[, t_idx]
  thresh_scalar <- get_youden(p_event_scalar_tr, truth120_train)

  # ── 2. Loglogistic lfAFT ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fit_faft2 <- fit_lfAFT(data = train_data, y = "time_since_use", delta = "is_user",
                           x = "^pct_chg_", x_as_regex = TRUE, z = z_vars_fold,
                           family = "loglogistic", k = 20, basis = "cr", s_grid = sgrid1, se = FALSE)
  S_faft2    <- predict_lfAFT(fit_faft2, test_data,  type = "survival", times = tgrid)
  S_faft2_tr <- predict_lfAFT(fit_faft2, train_data, type = "survival", times = tgrid)
  eta_faft2    <- predict_lfAFT(fit_faft2, test_data,  type = "link")
  eta_faft2_tr <- predict_lfAFT(fit_faft2, train_data, type = "link")
  p_event_faft2    <- 1 - S_faft2[,    t_idx]
  p_event_faft2_tr <- 1 - S_faft2_tr[, t_idx]
  thresh_faft2 <- get_youden(p_event_faft2_tr, truth120_train)

  # ── 3. Lognormal lfAFT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fit_faft <- fit_lfAFT(data = train_data, y = "time_since_use", delta = "is_user",
                          x = "^pct_chg_", x_as_regex = TRUE, z = z_vars_fold,
                          family = "lognormal", k = 20, basis = "cr", s_grid = sgrid1, se = FALSE)
  S_faft    <- predict_lfAFT(fit_faft, test_data,  type = "survival", times = tgrid)
  S_faft_tr <- predict_lfAFT(fit_faft, train_data, type = "survival", times = tgrid)
  eta_faft    <- predict_lfAFT(fit_faft, test_data,  type = "link")
  eta_faft_tr <- predict_lfAFT(fit_faft, train_data, type = "link")
  p_event_faft    <- 1 - S_faft[,    t_idx]
  p_event_faft_tr <- 1 - S_faft_tr[, t_idx]
  thresh_faft <- get_youden(p_event_faft_tr, truth120_train)

  # ── 4. Lognormal afAFT ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fit_aaft <- fit_afAFT(data = train_data, y = "time_since_use", delta = "is_user",
                     x = "^pct_chg_", x_as_regex = TRUE, z = z_vars_fold,
                     family = "lognormal", k = 20, basis = "cr", s_grid = sgrid1)
  S_aaft    <- predict_afAFT(fit_aaft, test_data,  type = "survival", times = tgrid)
  S_aaft_tr <- predict_afAFT(fit_aaft, train_data, type = "survival", times = tgrid)
  p_event_aaft    <- 1 - S_aaft[,    t_idx]
  p_event_aaft_tr <- 1 - S_aaft_tr[, t_idx]
  thresh_aaft <- get_youden(p_event_aaft_tr, truth120_train)

  # ── 5. LFCM ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  na_mat_test  <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(test_data),  length(tgrid))
  na_mat_train <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(train_data), length(tgrid))
  lfcm_ok <- tryCatch({
    fit_lfcm  <- fit_mgcv(data = train_data, family = "LFCM", sgrid = sgrid1, compute_surv = FALSE, z_vars = z_vars_fold)[[1]]
    S_lfcm    <- cal_stime(fit = fit_lfcm, data = test_data2,  tgrid = tgrid, family = "cox.ph")
    S_lfcm_tr <- cal_stime(fit = fit_lfcm, data = train_data2, tgrid = tgrid, family = "cox.ph")
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) { message("LFCM fold ", k, " failed: ", e$message); FALSE })
  if (!lfcm_ok) { fit_lfcm <- NULL; S_lfcm <- na_mat_test; S_lfcm_tr <- na_mat_train }
  p_event_lfcm    <- 1 - S_lfcm[,    t_idx]
  p_event_lfcm_tr <- 1 - S_lfcm_tr[, t_idx]
  thresh_lfcm <- get_youden(p_event_lfcm_tr, truth120_train)

  # ── 6. AFCM ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  afcm_ok <- tryCatch({
    fit_afcm  <- fit_mgcv(data = train_data, family = "AFCM", sgrid = sgrid1, compute_surv = FALSE, z_vars = z_vars_fold)[[1]]
    S_afcm    <- cal_stime(fit = fit_afcm, data = test_data2,  tgrid = tgrid, family = "cox.ph")
    S_afcm_tr <- cal_stime(fit = fit_afcm, data = train_data2, tgrid = tgrid, family = "cox.ph")
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) { message("AFCM fold ", k, " failed: ", e$message); FALSE })
  if (!afcm_ok) { fit_afcm <- NULL; S_afcm <- na_mat_test; S_afcm_tr <- na_mat_train }
  p_event_afcm    <- 1 - S_afcm[,    t_idx]
  p_event_afcm_tr <- 1 - S_afcm_tr[, t_idx]
  thresh_afcm <- get_youden(p_event_afcm_tr, truth120_train)

  # ── 7. Functional logistic (binary at t_eval) ─────────────────────────────
  fit_logistic     <- pfr(as.formula(paste("is_user_120 ~", paste(z_vars_fold, collapse = " + "), "+ lf(X_mat, argvals = sgrid1)")),
                          family = binomial(), method = "REML", data = train_data)
  pred_logistic_tr <- predict(fit_logistic, newdata = train_data, type = "response")
  pred_logistic    <- predict(fit_logistic, newdata = test_data,  type = "response")
  thresh_logistic  <- get_youden(pred_logistic_tr, truth120_train)


  # ── IPCW Integrated Brier Score ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  IBS_cv[k, "scalar lognormal AFT"] <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_scalar,    time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_cv[k, "loglogistic lfAFT"]    <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_faft2,     time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_cv[k, "lognormal lfAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_faft,      time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_cv[k, "lognormal afAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_aaft,      time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_cv[k, "LFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_lfcm,      time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_cv[k, "AFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_afcm,      time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  
  # IBS_cv[k, "scalar lognormal AFT"] <- cal_Brier(S_scalar,    time_test,  event_test,  tgrid)
  # IBS_cv[k, "loglogistic lfAFT"]    <- cal_Brier(S_faft2,     time_test,  event_test,  tgrid)
  # IBS_cv[k, "lognormal lfAFT"]      <- cal_Brier(S_faft,      time_test,  event_test,  tgrid)
  # IBS_cv[k, "lognormal afAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_aaft,      time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  # IBS_cv[k, "LFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_lfcm,      time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  # IBS_cv[k, "AFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_afcm,      time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, tgrid)

  IBS_tr[k, "scalar lognormal AFT"] <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_scalar_tr, time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_tr[k, "loglogistic lfAFT"]    <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_faft2_tr,  time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_tr[k, "lognormal lfAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_faft_tr,   time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_tr[k, "lognormal afAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_aaft_tr,   time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_tr[k, "LFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_lfcm_tr,   time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_tr[k, "AFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_afcm_tr,   time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, tgrid)

  # ── Time-specific IPCW Brier Score at 60 min ──────────────────────────────
  BS60_cv[k, "scalar lognormal AFT"] <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_scalar[,    t_idx60], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_cv[k, "loglogistic lfAFT"]    <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_faft2[,     t_idx60], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_cv[k, "lognormal lfAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_faft[,      t_idx60], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_cv[k, "lognormal afAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_aaft[,      t_idx60], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_cv[k, "LFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_lfcm[,      t_idx60], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_cv[k, "AFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_afcm[,      t_idx60], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_cv[k, "func logistic"]        <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(1 - pred_logistic,      time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, 60)

  BS60_tr[k, "scalar lognormal AFT"] <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_scalar_tr[, t_idx60], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_tr[k, "loglogistic lfAFT"]    <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_faft2_tr[,  t_idx60], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_tr[k, "lognormal lfAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_faft_tr[,   t_idx60], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_tr[k, "lognormal afAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_aaft_tr[,   t_idx60], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_tr[k, "LFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_lfcm_tr[,   t_idx60], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_tr[k, "AFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_afcm_tr[,   t_idx60], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_tr[k, "func logistic"]        <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(1 - pred_logistic_tr,   time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, 60)

  # ── Time-specific IPCW Brier Score at t_eval ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  BS120_cv[k, "scalar lognormal AFT"] <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_scalar[,    t_idx], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_cv[k, "loglogistic lfAFT"]    <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_faft2[,     t_idx], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_cv[k, "lognormal lfAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_faft[,      t_idx], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_cv[k, "lognormal afAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_aaft[,      t_idx], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_cv[k, "LFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_lfcm[,      t_idx], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_cv[k, "AFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_afcm[,      t_idx], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_cv[k, "func logistic"]        <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(1 - pred_logistic,    time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, t_eval)

  BS120_tr[k, "scalar lognormal AFT"] <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_scalar_tr[, t_idx], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_tr[k, "loglogistic lfAFT"]    <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_faft2_tr[,  t_idx], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_tr[k, "lognormal lfAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_faft_tr[,   t_idx], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_tr[k, "lognormal afAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_aaft_tr[,   t_idx], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_tr[k, "LFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_lfcm_tr[,   t_idx], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_tr[k, "AFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_afcm_tr[,   t_idx], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_tr[k, "func logistic"]        <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(1 - pred_logistic_tr, time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, t_eval)


  # ── Uno's IPCW C-index ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Cindex_cv[k, "scalar lognormal AFT"] <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_test,  lpnew = -eta_scalar)
  Cindex_cv[k, "loglogistic lfAFT"]    <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_test,  lpnew = -eta_faft2)
  Cindex_cv[k, "lognormal lfAFT"]      <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_test,  lpnew = -eta_faft)
  Cindex_cv[k, "lognormal afAFT"]      <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_test,  lpnew = -predict(fit_aaft, test_data2,  type = "link"))
  Cindex_cv[k, "LFCM"]                 <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_test,  lpnew =  predict(fit_lfcm, test_data2,  type = "link"))
  Cindex_cv[k, "AFCM"]                 <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_test,  lpnew =  predict(fit_afcm, test_data2,  type = "link"))
  Cindex_cv[k, "func logistic"]        <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_test,  lpnew = pred_logistic)

  Cindex_tr[k, "scalar lognormal AFT"] <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_train, lpnew = -eta_scalar_tr)
  Cindex_tr[k, "loglogistic lfAFT"]    <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_train, lpnew = -eta_faft2_tr)
  Cindex_tr[k, "lognormal lfAFT"]      <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_train, lpnew = -eta_faft_tr)
  Cindex_tr[k, "lognormal afAFT"]      <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_train, lpnew = -predict(fit_aaft, train_data2, type = "link"))
  Cindex_tr[k, "LFCM"]                 <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_train, lpnew =  predict(fit_lfcm, train_data2, type = "link"))
  Cindex_tr[k, "AFCM"]                 <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_train, lpnew =  predict(fit_afcm, train_data2, type = "link"))
  Cindex_tr[k, "func logistic"]        <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_train, lpnew = pred_logistic_tr)

  # ── Sensitivity / Specificity at t_eval (Youden's threshold) ──────────────────────────────────
  ss_list <- list(
    sens_spec(p_event_scalar, thresh_scalar,   truth120),
    sens_spec(p_event_faft2,  thresh_faft2,    truth120),
    sens_spec(p_event_faft,   thresh_faft,     truth120),
    sens_spec(p_event_aaft,   thresh_aaft,     truth120),
    sens_spec(p_event_lfcm,   thresh_lfcm,     truth120),
    sens_spec(p_event_afcm,   thresh_afcm,     truth120),
    sens_spec(pred_logistic,  thresh_logistic, truth120)
  )
  Sens_cv[k, ] <- sapply(ss_list, `[[`, "sens")
  Spec_cv[k, ] <- sapply(ss_list, `[[`, "spec")

  ss_list_tr <- list(
    sens_spec(p_event_scalar_tr, thresh_scalar,   truth120_train),
    sens_spec(p_event_faft2_tr,  thresh_faft2,    truth120_train),
    sens_spec(p_event_faft_tr,   thresh_faft,     truth120_train),
    sens_spec(p_event_aaft_tr,   thresh_aaft,     truth120_train),
    sens_spec(p_event_lfcm_tr,   thresh_lfcm,     truth120_train),
    sens_spec(p_event_afcm_tr,   thresh_afcm,     truth120_train),
    sens_spec(pred_logistic_tr,  thresh_logistic, truth120_train)
  )
  Sens_tr[k, ] <- sapply(ss_list_tr, `[[`, "sens")
  Spec_tr[k, ] <- sapply(ss_list_tr, `[[`, "spec")
}

# ── Results summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cm <- function(x) round(colMeans(x, na.rm = TRUE), 4)
df_cv1 <- data.frame(
  Model      = model_names,
  IBS_CV     = round(c(cm(IBS_cv),    NA), 4),
  IBS_Train  = round(c(cm(IBS_tr),    NA), 4),
  BS60_CV    = cm(BS60_cv),
  BS60_Train = cm(BS60_tr),
  BS120_CV   = cm(BS120_cv),
  BS120_Train = cm(BS120_tr),
  Cindex_CV  = cm(Cindex_cv),
  Cindex_Train = cm(Cindex_tr),
  Sens_CV    = cm(Sens_cv),
  Sens_Train = cm(Sens_tr),
  Spec_CV    = cm(Spec_cv),
  Spec_Train = cm(Spec_tr)
)
cat("\n=== Assessment 1: 10-Fold CV Results ===\n")
print(df_cv1)
```

```{r cross validation 2}
# ── Cross-validation setup (Assessment 2) ────────────────────────────────────
keep_cols2 <- c("time_since_use", "is_user", z_vars,
                grep("^pct_chg_", colnames(df_post2_r), value = TRUE))
cv_data2 <- df_post2_r[, keep_cols2]

set.seed(916)
n_folds <- 10
fold    <- createFolds(cv_data2$time_since_use, k = n_folds, list = FALSE)
# make_data2, cal_IPCW_IBS, cal_IPCW_BS_t defined in previous chunk
t_eval  <- 120


# Helpers for creating metric matrices (inherited from chunk 1)
new_mat2      <- function() matrix(NA, n_folds, 7,      dimnames = list(NULL, model_names))
new_mat2_surv <- function() matrix(NA, n_folds, n_surv, dimnames = list(NULL, model_names[1:6]))

get_youden <- function(prob_tr, truth_tr) {
  if (length(unique(na.omit(truth_tr))) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  tryCatch({
    roc_obj <- roc(truth_tr, prob_tr, quiet = TRUE)
    as.numeric(unlist(coords(roc_obj, "best", best.method = "youden", ret = "threshold")))[1]
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
}

IBS_cv2    <- new_mat2_surv(); IBS_tr2    <- new_mat2_surv()
BS60_cv2   <- new_mat2();      BS60_tr2   <- new_mat2()
BS120_cv2  <- new_mat2();      BS120_tr2  <- new_mat2()
Cindex_cv2 <- new_mat2();      Cindex_tr2 <- new_mat2()
Sens_cv2   <- new_mat2();      Sens_tr2   <- new_mat2()
Spec_cv2   <- new_mat2();      Spec_tr2   <- new_mat2()
for (k in 1:n_folds) {
  cat(sprintf("Assessment 2 — Fold %d / %d\n", k, n_folds))

  train_data <- cv_data2[-which(fold == k), ]
  test_data  <- cv_data2[ which(fold == k), ]

  train_data$X_mat       <- as.matrix(train_data[, grep("^pct_chg_", colnames(train_data))])
  test_data$X_mat        <- as.matrix(test_data[,  grep("^pct_chg_", colnames(test_data))])
  train_data$is_user_120 <- as.integer(train_data$time_since_use <= t_eval)
  test_data$is_user_120  <- as.integer(test_data$time_since_use  <= t_eval)

  time_train  <- train_data$time_since_use; event_train <- train_data$is_user
  time_test   <- test_data$time_since_use;  event_test  <- test_data$is_user
  Surv_train  <- Surv(time_train, event_train)
  Surv_test   <- Surv(time_test,  event_test)
  truth120       <- as.integer(time_test  <= t_eval & event_test  == 1)
  truth120_train <- as.integer(time_train <= t_eval & event_train == 1)
  t_idx   <- which.min(abs(tgrid - t_eval))
  t_idx60 <- which.min(abs(tgrid - 60))

  # Drop z_vars with zero/near-zero variance in this training fold
  z_vars_fold <- z_vars[vapply(z_vars, function(v) {
    x <- train_data[[v]]; !all(is.na(x)) && var(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 1e-10
  }, logical(1))]
  if (length(z_vars_fold) == 0) z_vars_fold <- z_vars[1]


  train_data2 <- make_data2(train_data, sgrid2, z_vars = z_vars_fold)
  test_data2  <- make_data2(test_data,  sgrid2, z_vars = z_vars_fold)

  get_youden <- function(prob_tr, truth_tr) {
    if (length(unique(na.omit(truth_tr))) < 2) return(NA_real_)
    tryCatch({
      roc_obj <- roc(truth_tr, prob_tr, quiet = TRUE)
      as.numeric(unlist(coords(roc_obj, "best", best.method = "youden", ret = "threshold")))[1]
    }, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  }
  sens_spec <- function(p_event, thresh, truth) {
    pred <- as.integer(p_event > thresh)
    list(sens = if (any(truth == 1)) mean(pred[truth == 1]) else NA,
         spec = if (any(truth == 0)) mean(1 - pred[truth == 0]) else NA)
  }

  # ── 1. Scalar lognormal AFT ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  scalar_form   <- as.formula(paste("Surv(time_since_use, is_user) ~", paste(z_vars_fold, collapse = " + ")))
  fit_scalar    <- survreg(scalar_form, data = train_data, dist = "lognormal")
  sigma_scalar  <- fit_scalar$scale
  eta_scalar    <- predict(fit_scalar, newdata = test_data,  type = "lp")
  eta_scalar_tr <- predict(fit_scalar, newdata = train_data, type = "lp")
  S_scalar    <- outer(eta_scalar,    tgrid, function(mu, t) pnorm((log(t) - mu) / sigma_scalar, lower.tail = FALSE))
  S_scalar_tr <- outer(eta_scalar_tr, tgrid, function(mu, t) pnorm((log(t) - mu) / sigma_scalar, lower.tail = FALSE))
  p_event_scalar    <- 1 - S_scalar[,    t_idx]
  p_event_scalar_tr <- 1 - S_scalar_tr[, t_idx]
  thresh_scalar <- get_youden(p_event_scalar_tr, truth120_train)

  # ── 2. Loglogistic lfAFT ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fit_faft2 <- fit_lfAFT(data = train_data, y = "time_since_use", delta = "is_user",
                           x = "^pct_chg_", x_as_regex = TRUE, z = z_vars_fold,
                           family = "loglogistic", k = 20, basis = "bs", s_grid = sgrid2, se = FALSE)
  S_faft2    <- predict_lfAFT(fit_faft2, test_data,  type = "survival", times = tgrid)
  S_faft2_tr <- predict_lfAFT(fit_faft2, train_data, type = "survival", times = tgrid)
  eta_faft2    <- predict_lfAFT(fit_faft2, test_data,  type = "link")
  eta_faft2_tr <- predict_lfAFT(fit_faft2, train_data, type = "link")
  p_event_faft2    <- 1 - S_faft2[,    t_idx]
  p_event_faft2_tr <- 1 - S_faft2_tr[, t_idx]
  thresh_faft2 <- get_youden(p_event_faft2_tr, truth120_train)

  # ── 3. Lognormal lfAFT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fit_faft <- fit_lfAFT(data = train_data, y = "time_since_use", delta = "is_user",
                          x = "^pct_chg_", x_as_regex = TRUE, z = z_vars_fold,
                          family = "lognormal", k = 20, basis = "bs", s_grid = sgrid2, se = FALSE)
  S_faft    <- predict_lfAFT(fit_faft, test_data,  type = "survival", times = tgrid)
  S_faft_tr <- predict_lfAFT(fit_faft, train_data, type = "survival", times = tgrid)
  eta_faft    <- predict_lfAFT(fit_faft, test_data,  type = "link")
  eta_faft_tr <- predict_lfAFT(fit_faft, train_data, type = "link")
  p_event_faft    <- 1 - S_faft[,    t_idx]
  p_event_faft_tr <- 1 - S_faft_tr[, t_idx]
  thresh_faft <- get_youden(p_event_faft_tr, truth120_train)

  # ── 4. Lognormal afAFT ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fit_aaft <- fit_afAFT(data = train_data, y = "time_since_use", delta = "is_user",
                     x = "^pct_chg_", x_as_regex = TRUE, z = z_vars_fold,
                     family = "lognormal", k = 20, basis = "bs", s_grid = sgrid2)
  S_aaft    <- predict_afAFT(fit_aaft, test_data,  type = "survival", times = tgrid)
  S_aaft_tr <- predict_afAFT(fit_aaft, train_data, type = "survival", times = tgrid)
  p_event_aaft    <- 1 - S_aaft[,    t_idx]
  p_event_aaft_tr <- 1 - S_aaft_tr[, t_idx]
  thresh_aaft <- get_youden(p_event_aaft_tr, truth120_train)

  # ── 5. LFCM ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  na_mat_test  <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(test_data),  length(tgrid))
  na_mat_train <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(train_data), length(tgrid))
  lfcm_ok <- tryCatch({
    fit_lfcm  <- fit_mgcv(data = train_data, family = "LFCM", sgrid = sgrid2, visit = "post2", compute_surv = FALSE, z_vars = z_vars_fold)[[1]]
    S_lfcm    <- cal_stime(fit = fit_lfcm, data = test_data2,  tgrid = tgrid, family = "cox.ph")
    S_lfcm_tr <- cal_stime(fit = fit_lfcm, data = train_data2, tgrid = tgrid, family = "cox.ph")
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) { message("LFCM fold ", k, " failed: ", e$message); FALSE })
  if (!lfcm_ok) { fit_lfcm <- NULL; S_lfcm <- na_mat_test; S_lfcm_tr <- na_mat_train }
  p_event_lfcm    <- 1 - S_lfcm[,    t_idx]
  p_event_lfcm_tr <- 1 - S_lfcm_tr[, t_idx]
  thresh_lfcm <- get_youden(p_event_lfcm_tr, truth120_train)

  # ── 6. AFCM ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  afcm_ok <- tryCatch({
    fit_afcm  <- fit_mgcv(data = train_data, family = "AFCM", sgrid = sgrid2, visit = "post2", compute_surv = FALSE, z_vars = z_vars_fold)[[1]]
    S_afcm    <- cal_stime(fit = fit_afcm, data = test_data2,  tgrid = tgrid, family = "cox.ph")
    S_afcm_tr <- cal_stime(fit = fit_afcm, data = train_data2, tgrid = tgrid, family = "cox.ph")
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) { message("AFCM fold ", k, " failed: ", e$message); FALSE })
  if (!afcm_ok) { fit_afcm <- NULL; S_afcm <- na_mat_test; S_afcm_tr <- na_mat_train }
  p_event_afcm    <- 1 - S_afcm[,    t_idx]
  p_event_afcm_tr <- 1 - S_afcm_tr[, t_idx]
  thresh_afcm <- get_youden(p_event_afcm_tr, truth120_train)

  # ── 7. Functional logistic ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  fit_logistic     <- pfr(as.formula(paste("is_user_120 ~", paste(z_vars_fold, collapse = " + "), "+ lf(X_mat, argvals = sgrid2)")),
                          family = binomial(), method = "REML", data = train_data)
  pred_logistic_tr <- predict(fit_logistic, newdata = train_data, type = "response")
  pred_logistic    <- predict(fit_logistic, newdata = test_data,  type = "response")
  thresh_logistic  <- get_youden(pred_logistic_tr, truth120_train)


  # ── IPCW Integrated Brier Score ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  IBS_cv2[k, "scalar lognormal AFT"] <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_scalar,    time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_cv2[k, "loglogistic lfAFT"]    <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_faft2,     time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_cv2[k, "lognormal lfAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_faft,      time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_cv2[k, "lognormal afAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_aaft,      time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_cv2[k, "LFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_lfcm,      time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_cv2[k, "AFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_afcm,      time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, tgrid)

  IBS_tr2[k, "scalar lognormal AFT"] <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_scalar_tr, time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_tr2[k, "loglogistic lfAFT"]    <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_faft2_tr,  time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_tr2[k, "lognormal lfAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_faft_tr,   time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_tr2[k, "lognormal afAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_aaft_tr,   time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_tr2[k, "LFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_lfcm_tr,   time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, tgrid)
  IBS_tr2[k, "AFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_IBS(S_afcm_tr,   time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, tgrid)

  # ── Time-specific IPCW Brier Score at 60 min ──────────────────────────────
  BS60_cv2[k, "scalar lognormal AFT"] <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_scalar[,    t_idx60], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_cv2[k, "loglogistic lfAFT"]    <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_faft2[,     t_idx60], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_cv2[k, "lognormal lfAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_faft[,      t_idx60], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_cv2[k, "lognormal afAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_aaft[,      t_idx60], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_cv2[k, "LFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_lfcm[,      t_idx60], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_cv2[k, "AFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_afcm[,      t_idx60], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_cv2[k, "func logistic"]        <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(1 - pred_logistic,      time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, 60)

  BS60_tr2[k, "scalar lognormal AFT"] <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_scalar_tr[, t_idx60], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_tr2[k, "loglogistic lfAFT"]    <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_faft2_tr[,  t_idx60], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_tr2[k, "lognormal lfAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_faft_tr[,   t_idx60], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_tr2[k, "lognormal afAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_aaft_tr[,   t_idx60], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_tr2[k, "LFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_lfcm_tr[,   t_idx60], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_tr2[k, "AFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_afcm_tr[,   t_idx60], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, 60)
  BS60_tr2[k, "func logistic"]        <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(1 - pred_logistic_tr,   time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, 60)

  # ── Time-specific IPCW Brier Score at t_eval ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  BS120_cv2[k, "scalar lognormal AFT"] <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_scalar[,    t_idx], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_cv2[k, "loglogistic lfAFT"]    <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_faft2[,     t_idx], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_cv2[k, "lognormal lfAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_faft[,      t_idx], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_cv2[k, "lognormal afAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_aaft[,      t_idx], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_cv2[k, "LFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_lfcm[,      t_idx], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_cv2[k, "AFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_afcm[,      t_idx], time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_cv2[k, "func logistic"]        <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(1 - pred_logistic,    time_test,  event_test,  time_train, event_train, t_eval)

  BS120_tr2[k, "scalar lognormal AFT"] <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_scalar_tr[, t_idx], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_tr2[k, "loglogistic lfAFT"]    <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_faft2_tr[,  t_idx], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_tr2[k, "lognormal lfAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_faft_tr[,   t_idx], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_tr2[k, "lognormal afAFT"]      <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_aaft_tr[,   t_idx], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_tr2[k, "LFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_lfcm_tr[,   t_idx], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_tr2[k, "AFCM"]                 <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(S_afcm_tr[,   t_idx], time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, t_eval)
  BS120_tr2[k, "func logistic"]        <- cal_IPCW_BS_t(1 - pred_logistic_tr, time_train, event_train, time_train, event_train, t_eval)


  # ── Uno's IPCW C-index ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Cindex_cv2[k, "scalar lognormal AFT"] <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_test,  lpnew = -eta_scalar)
  Cindex_cv2[k, "loglogistic lfAFT"]    <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_test,  lpnew = -eta_faft2)
  Cindex_cv2[k, "lognormal lfAFT"]      <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_test,  lpnew = -eta_faft)
  Cindex_cv2[k, "lognormal afAFT"]      <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_test,  lpnew = -predict(fit_aaft, test_data2,  type = "link"))
  Cindex_cv2[k, "LFCM"]                 <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_test,  lpnew =  predict(fit_lfcm, test_data2,  type = "link"))
  Cindex_cv2[k, "AFCM"]                 <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_test,  lpnew =  predict(fit_afcm, test_data2,  type = "link"))
  Cindex_cv2[k, "func logistic"]        <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_test,  lpnew = pred_logistic)

  Cindex_tr2[k, "scalar lognormal AFT"] <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_train, lpnew = -eta_scalar_tr)
  Cindex_tr2[k, "loglogistic lfAFT"]    <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_train, lpnew = -eta_faft2_tr)
  Cindex_tr2[k, "lognormal lfAFT"]      <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_train, lpnew = -eta_faft_tr)
  Cindex_tr2[k, "lognormal afAFT"]      <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_train, lpnew = -predict(fit_aaft, train_data2, type = "link"))
  Cindex_tr2[k, "LFCM"]                 <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_train, lpnew =  predict(fit_lfcm, train_data2, type = "link"))
  Cindex_tr2[k, "AFCM"]                 <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_train, lpnew =  predict(fit_afcm, train_data2, type = "link"))
  Cindex_tr2[k, "func logistic"]        <- UnoC(Surv_train, Surv_train, lpnew = pred_logistic_tr)

  # ── Sensitivity / Specificity at t_eval (Youden's threshold) ──────────────────────────────────
  ss_list <- list(
    sens_spec(p_event_scalar, thresh_scalar,   truth120),
    sens_spec(p_event_faft2,  thresh_faft2,    truth120),
    sens_spec(p_event_faft,   thresh_faft,     truth120),
    sens_spec(p_event_aaft,   thresh_aaft,     truth120),
    sens_spec(p_event_lfcm,   thresh_lfcm,     truth120),
    sens_spec(p_event_afcm,   thresh_afcm,     truth120),
    sens_spec(pred_logistic,  thresh_logistic, truth120)
  )
  Sens_cv2[k, ] <- sapply(ss_list, `[[`, "sens")
  Spec_cv2[k, ] <- sapply(ss_list, `[[`, "spec")

  ss_list_tr <- list(
    sens_spec(p_event_scalar_tr, thresh_scalar,   truth120_train),
    sens_spec(p_event_faft2_tr,  thresh_faft2,    truth120_train),
    sens_spec(p_event_faft_tr,   thresh_faft,     truth120_train),
    sens_spec(p_event_aaft_tr,   thresh_aaft,     truth120_train),
    sens_spec(p_event_lfcm_tr,   thresh_lfcm,     truth120_train),
    sens_spec(p_event_afcm_tr,   thresh_afcm,     truth120_train),
    sens_spec(pred_logistic_tr,  thresh_logistic, truth120_train)
  )
  Sens_tr2[k, ] <- sapply(ss_list_tr, `[[`, "sens")
  Spec_tr2[k, ] <- sapply(ss_list_tr, `[[`, "spec")
}

# ── Results summary ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cm2 <- function(x) round(colMeans(x, na.rm = TRUE), 4)
df_cv2 <- data.frame(
  Model        = model_names,
  IBS_CV       = round(c(cm2(IBS_cv2),    NA), 4),
  IBS_Train    = round(c(cm2(IBS_tr2),    NA), 4),
  BS60_CV      = cm2(BS60_cv2),
  BS60_Train   = cm2(BS60_tr2),
  BS120_CV     = cm2(BS120_cv2),
  BS120_Train  = cm2(BS120_tr2),
  Cindex_CV    = cm2(Cindex_cv2),
  Cindex_Train = cm2(Cindex_tr2),
  Sens_CV      = cm2(Sens_cv2),
  Sens_Train   = cm2(Sens_tr2),
  Spec_CV      = cm2(Spec_cv2),
  Spec_Train   = cm2(Spec_tr2)
)
cat("\n=== Assessment 2: 10-Fold CV Results ===\n")
print(df_cv2)
```

```{r, hazard function}
### Define the hazard function
hazard_function <- function(t, lambda, alpha) {
  return((lambda*alpha*(lambda*t)^(alpha-1))/(1+(lambda*t)^alpha))
}

t_values <- seq(0, 125, length.out = 200)

# AFT model (fit1.laft removed; these lines need updating if hazard plots are needed)
# lp <- predict(fit1.laft[[1]], type = "link")
# lambda_values <- round(1/exp(lp), 4)[1:10]
# b_values <- as.numeric(gsub(".*\(([^)]+)\).*", "\1", fit1.laft[[1]]$family$family))
lp <- predict(fit1.lfcm[[1]], type = "link")
lambda_values <- round(1/exp(lp), 4)[1:10]  # Varying lambda values (using LFCM LP as placeholder)
b_values <- c(1)  # placeholder
data_list <- list()
# Loop over values of lambda and b to populate data
for (i in seq_along(lambda_values)) {
  for (b in b_values) {
    alpha = 1/b
    h_values <- hazard_function(tgrid, lambda_values[i], alpha)
    temp_data <- data.frame(
      subject = i,
      t = tgrid,
      hazard = h_values,
      b = as.factor(b), 
      lambda = as.factor(lambda_values[i])
    )
    data_list[[length(data_list) + 1]] <- temp_data
  }
}
final_data <- do.call(rbind, data_list)

# Plot the hazard function
ggplot(final_data, aes(x = t, y = hazard, color = as.factor(subject))) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Estimated Hazard", color = "Subject",
       title = "Estimated Hazard Functions for First 6 Subjects",
       subtitle = "Linear Functional AFT Model (b = 1.267)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Cox model
lp <- predict(fit1.lfcm[[1]], type = "link")
fit <- fit1.lfcm[[1]]
t0 <- rev(fit$family$data$tr) # observed event times
H0_hat <- rev(fit$family$data$h) # Breslow estimator of the cumulative hazard function
H0_fit <- scam(H0_hat ~ s(t0, bs = "mpi") - 1) # smooth while imposing non-decreasing shape constraints
# evaluate smoothed H0 on fine grid
H0_prd <- pmax(0, predict(H0_fit, newdata = data.frame(t0 = tgrid)))
# approximate the baseline hazard function from cumulative hazard
h0 <- c(H0_prd[1], diff(H0_prd))  # h0(t) = dH0(t)/dt
hazard_est <- exp(lp) %o% h0 
  
  # Prepare data for ggplot
hazard_df <- as.data.frame(t(hazard_est))
hazard_df$time <- tgrid  # Add time points
hazard_df <- pivot_longer(hazard_df, cols = -time, names_to = "subject", values_to = "hazard")

# Plot
ggplot(hazard_df, aes(x = time, y = hazard, color = subject)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Estimated Hazard",
       title = "Estimated Hazard Functions for First 6 Subjects",
       subtitle = "LFCM") +
  theme_minimal()

# Combined plot
ggplot(hazard_df) +
  geom_line(aes(x = time, y = hazard, color = "LFCM")) +
  geom_line(data = final_data, aes(x = t, y = hazard, color = "Linear AFT")) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Model",
                     values = c("LFCM" = "blue", "Linear AFT" = "red")) +
  labs(x = "t (minutes)", y = "Estimated Hazard",
       title = "Estimated Hazard Function for An Average Individual",
       subtitle = "age = 31, bmi = 25.4") +
  theme_minimal()
```
